operation.summary: List the models this key may call now
operation.description: Live-revalidated, catalog-eligible models of the key's workspace (http.rs models; catalog.rs key_models). Advisory: admission re-checks everything. No query parameter is read; unknown ones are ignored. A key invalidated since authentication is refused exactly like an unknown key.

200.description: The models, ordered by public name

operation.description: String-only, non-streaming embeddings (protocols/embeddings.rs). Embeddings are an input-only workload: usage never has completion tokens. A capability no deployment supports is 501 unsupported_capability (not the 400 of the other workloads). Oversized bodies: the shared 2 MiB cap.

body_bytes.source: apps/gateway/src/http.rs request body cap (fixed, not configurable)

200.description: The embeddings, one per input, in input order

operation.description: Cohere v2 / Jina-style subset (protocols/rerank.rs). Request validation and an unsupported model/protocol pair are both 400, told apart by error.code.

200.description: Relevance scores of at most top_n documents, in provider order

operation.description: OpenAI-compatible subset (protocols/images.rs): base64 images only, never URLs. Unknown fields (output_format, background, style, user, ...) are refused with 400 invalid_request_error.

200.description: The generated images and observed usage

operation.summary: Answer typed System One questions about a state
operation.description: TypeSafe System One contract (protocols/systemone.rs). Validation failures are 422 invalid_request_error like TypeSafe; an unsupported model/protocol pair or image state parts are 400 unsupported_capability. Gateway billing never appears in the body.

200.description: One answer per question, with observed input and output tokens

422.description: Request validation failure (TypeSafe-compatible): the closed field set, a bound, a type, the question criteria of its kind

operation.description: Explicitly unsupported and never minted upstream (protocols/realtime.rs unsupported_route; routed at http.rs). Any body is ignored; the answer is always the 400 below once the key authenticates. Use GET /v1/realtime over WebSocket instead.

n.description: Images to generate, 1 to 4 (default 1); exactly this many are returned.

seed.description: Largest JSON-safe integer is the maximum (IMAGE_MAX_SEED). A deployment that cannot honor a seed is refused with 400 unsupported_capability.
